alerts.desc: SQL injection may be possible. The attacker is able to craft SQL queries that are executed against the database.
alerts.solution: Do not trust client-side input. Escape all data received from the client. Apply an allowlist of acceptable inputs that strictly conform to specifications. Implement parameterized queries or stored procedures.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.desc: The response does not protect against clickjacking attacks. It should include either Content-Security-Policy with the frame-ancestors directive or X-Frame-Options header.
alerts.solution: Modern Web browsers support the Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options HTTP headers. Ensure one of them is set on all web pages returned by your site.
